name: CloudEagle.ai
description:
CloudEagle.ai is an AI-powered SaaS Management, AI Governance, and SaaS Security platform that gives enterprises one command center to discover, secure, govern, and optimize their entire SaaS and AI stack, including AI usage control and both human and non-human identities.

Trusted by RingCentral, Automation Anywhere, Shiji, and Rec Room, CloudEagle helps organizations save 10–30% on software spend while managing hundreds of SaaS and AI apps, without disrupting existing tools.

CloudEagle governs applications, identities, and non-human identities (service accounts, bots, API keys, AI agents) continuously, rationalizing redundant tools and tracking security posture against frameworks like NIST 800. Onboarding takes 30 minutes; savings and governance start day one. To date: $50B+ in spend processed, $3B+ saved.

With 500+ integrations, CloudEagle eliminates shadow SaaS and AI, enforces AI usage policies, and secures non-human identities. Slack-enabled, no-code workflows automate onboarding/offboarding, access reviews, license harvesting, and just-in-time access, while an autonomous agent triggers renewals and routes approvals through Slack, Jira, or ServiceNow.

By correlating IT, HR, Finance, and Security data, CloudEagle surfaces hidden risk, unauthorized AI use, excessive privileges, orphaned identities, and overspend, backed by usage benchmarking that strengthens every vendor negotiation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CloudEagle.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CloudEagle.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.cloudeagle.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CloudEagle.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CloudEagle.ai lists 35 MCP tools, including analyze_application_contracts, create_renewal_workflow, get_ai_chargeback_by_department, get_ai_chargeback_summary, get_ai_consumption_usage, get_ai_consumption_usage_by_period, get_ai_usage_breakdown, get_application_details, get_application_duplicate_apps, get_application_licenses, get_company_settings, and get_dashboard_summary.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CloudEagle.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CloudEagle.ai in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
CloudEagle.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CloudEagle.ai is developed by CloudEagle.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
